If rendered literally, the result would read '...were only the tip of the iceberg of the transformation they would they would experience.' -- 'they would' is duplicated. Either (a) the passage blank should extend to cover 'they would experience' making it '______ experience.' or (b) wa should be 'were only the tip of the iceberg of the transformation' (9 words) and stem should say 9 words with matching tokens. The provided tokens in stem also include 'they' and 'would' which confirms the intent was 12 words, but the passage text contradicts this.
